## Purpose

Describe the user-visible or operational outcome of this change.

## Validation

- [ ] Targeted tests pass
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes when runtime behavior changed

## Safety

- [ ] Baseline and personal-skill reviews remain permanently local-only
- [ ] No review/training publication, approval, vote, status, label, or branch mutation was added
- [ ] Human ground truth is not exposed to review models
- [ ] New automation uses least-privilege permissions and pinned Actions

## Human decision

- [ ] A code owner reviewed behavior, permissions, and rollback considerations
- [ ] Any intentional benchmark behavior change is documented
